calls.title: Visual Editor early access
calls.summary: The team discussed launching an early access program for the visual editor aimed at gathering user feedback and promoting upgrades. They agreed on targeting Pro and Enterprise users, with a 30-day Pro trial offered to free users, and emphasized collecting feedback through Slack and community channels. The manual enabling of the feature for up to 50 participants was deemed manageable, with some exclusions for open source users. Promotion strategies included direct outreach via Slack and email, while feedback would be collected post-trial through surveys. The status of AI features was re-evaluated, shifting towards usage-based token charging. The Figma integration prototype was also ready for beta, focusing on enhancing user experience.
calls.keywords: Visual Editor, Early Access, Pro Trial, Lead Capture, Google Extension, Figma Integration
